entries.subject: case:blocked-predicate-unmapped-code__anonymous_assert_by_reference
entries.reason: `assert positive;` (an anonymous assertion of a named constraint): the screen refuses it as blocked_predicate and the generator refuses it SI_ID_UNSTABLE, so both refuse with codes that do not map. P3 fixed agentic-mbse's occurrence copy so the screen indexes it as codegen does. The generator's refusal fails closed, so this is not an RG-1 candidate; the SiteReason that would map it is P5's. The case lives in codegen's home (D14), not agentic-mbse's package: the records cannot cite it for the refused pair, because a cited refused case must show the mapped code (SI_CONSTRAINT_BLOCKED) and this one does not.
